changes: New: VECTOR is a MIDI generator for the eight MIDI tracks. Double-tap a MIDI track's key (or double-tap SRC) and choose VECTOR in MIDI NOTE SETUP's list. Its controls take the SRC page (TYPE, DENS, ROOT, SCAL, OCT, SEED) and the AMP page (VEL, ACNT, GATE, SPAN, OFST, RPT; FUNC+AMP: ROT, DIR, PROB, HUMN); LFO, FX1 and FX2 stay the track's own. OCT, VEL and GATE are the track's NOTE, VEL and LEN, so a trig placed by hand fits the phrase. PROB gives the notes off the beat a trig condition (99% down to 1%) and HUMN a micro-timing offset of up to 23/24 of a step. It writes real note trigs with NOTE, VEL and LEN locks that the Octatrack's own MIDI sequencer plays, so tempo, track speed, swing, the channel and every note-off stay stock's. Over USB it needs a Modwerk base with MIDI generators; a card build brings its own.

Faster edits on both kinds of track: a control turn no longer rebuilds the lock index of all 16 tracks (about 3 ms on the unit), the scale's pitches are worked out once a phrase instead of once a step, and the MIDI phrase is written in place. A 64-step rewrite took 0.5 ms on the owner's MKII; the audio frames and the MIDI timing stayed steady while turning. The generated phrases are the same as 0.2.4's.
VECTOR's audio tick reads the Part and track numbers once a tick, and its key layer stays off in MIDI mode.

Tested on the owner's MKII over USB with development bases (21 and 24 October 2026): the list, the SRC, AMP and FUNC+AMP pages, generation, OCT, ROOT, VEL and GATE, PROB at 1% (only the notes on the beat played) and HUMN (every note within 1 ms of its written offset), holding a trig in grid recording (stock's page and locks), OFF, removal and reinstall. Not tested: a card build on the unit, a physical power cycle, project save and reload, scenes and LFOs on a VECTOR MIDI track, MKI. While VECTOR is not installed, a VECTOR MIDI track's ARP SETUP shows its stored controls as arp notes. The STATIC/FLEX bank problem of #596 is not addressed.
Fixes saved VECTOR settings making the Octatrack reject the bank at startup, which reset machines to STATIC and left PLAY stuck on the first step. Existing settings are kept.
Projects already reset by this bug need to be restored from a backup.
Installs over USB beside every other module on the Modwerk beta base.
Documentation only: switching a VECTOR track back to STATIC or FLEX with SPAN 8 or higher can empty the bank after a save and reboot; the guide shows how to avoid it (#596).
Known issue: #596 is not fixed, and a reboot and the audio are not yet tested on hardware.
First Modwerk release of VECTOR, an SRC pattern generator for Flex and Static sample phrases.
Adds sample selection and two control pages; generated phrases edit the current pattern.
Known issue: saved projects and hardware are not yet tested.
